description: Get the corporate group of a Polish company from the global LEI register (GLEIF), supplemented with foreign corporate shareholders from KRS matched to it: direct parent and ultimate parent (name, country, LEI), subsidiaries and other group companies — Polish ones with KRS number, foreign ones with country — and group size. Answers 'who owns this company', 'which concern does it belong to', 'other companies of the group in Poland and abroad'. Keyed by KRS. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

limit.description: Max group companies per list (default 50, max 200).

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

name: get_company_group
title: Get Corporate Group (GLEIF LEI register)
